data_provenance.source_dataset: ResolveFlow internally authored business regression scenarios
data_provenance.license: project-local; no external dataset rows redistributed
data_provenance.adaptation_method: New synthetic business fixtures, inspired by independent-state verification; not translated benchmark tasks
data_provenance.leakage_note: Created during implementation and visible to developers. Must not be called a held-out test set. Future independent evaluation requires a separately frozen family-level split.

expected_outcome_rate.scope: All internal regression scenarios; safe pauses count here, not as completed tasks

business_task_completion_rate.scope: All scenarios including intentional pauses/rejections; completion is requested-goal scoped

unassisted_completion_rate.scope: No reviewer; deterministic mode is NOT AI independent completion

correct_human_takeover_rate.scope: Expected human handling, not AI task completion

checkpoint_recovery_rate.scope: New runtime instance reads exactly the persisted task; not a SIGKILL test
